texto: Specific verbs and adjectives are used to describe problems at home: «De kraan lekt» (the tap drips), «De verwarming is kapot» (the heating is broken). «sinds»: «sinds vanochtend» (from this morning) is used to indicate the start of the problem. «Laten weten» is a key perifrase that means «Notify» or «let you know».

frases.nl: De kraan in de keuken lekt.
frases.es: El grifo de la cocina gotea.

frases.nl: Sinds vanochtend. De verwarming is ook kapot.
frases.es: Desde esta mañana. La calefacción también está estropeada.
frases.en: Since this morning. The heating is also damaged.

frases.nl: Dank u. Kunt u mij laten weten hoe laat?
frases.en: Thank you. Can you tell me what time?

bloques.pregunta: What specific failures does the tenant communicate to the owner?

opciones.texto: The kitchen tap drips and the heating is damaged
opciones.explicacion: He mentions two incidents: «kraan lekt» and «verwarming kapot».

opciones.texto: The glass of the living room window has broken
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't mention a glass break in the windows.

opciones.texto: The lock on the main door does not open
opciones.explicacion: He has no problem with locksmith, but with plumbing and heating.

bloques.pregunta: Since when do these problems persist?
bloques.frase: Sinds vanochtend. De verwarming is ook kapot.

opciones.explicacion: «Sinds vanochtend» states that it started this very morning.
It hasn't been two weeks, it started that same morning.
It doesn't go back to the previous weekend.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the professional who will send the landlord.

opciones.explicacion: «Monteur» is the technician or specialist who comes to repair the failure.
«Huurder» is the tenant who suffers the problem.
«Verhuurder» is the owner of the service.

bloques.pregunta: What does the Dutch expression «laten weten» mean?

opciones.explicacion: Common periodosis to request confirmation of time or data.

bloques.pregunta: What does the tenant ask after knowing that a technician will go?
bloques.frase: Kunt u mij laten weten hoe laat?

opciones.texto: Let him know the exact time of the visit.
opciones.explicacion: «Hoe laat» asks what time the professional will come.

opciones.texto: Send the invoice before the repair begins
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't ask for the budget, he asks for the time of arrival.

opciones.texto: To lower the amount of the monthly rental
opciones.explicacion: He does not consider negotiating the rent in this conversation.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the right verb to indicate that the tap loses water.

opciones.explicacion: «Lekt» means dripping or having water leaks.
It does not express the malfunction of the tap.

bloques.frase: De kraan in de keuken lekt
bloques.explicacion: Subject with prepositional synthma and intransitive verb of failure.

intro: It communicates domestic failures to the owner and agrees to a visit by a technician.
